    Initialize points using repulsive forces to spread them out.
    """
    X = _fibonacci_sphere(n)
    
    for _ in range(n_iter):
        # Compute pairwise distances
        dots = X @ X.T
        dots = np.clip(dots, -1.0, 1.0)
        angles = np.arccos(dots)
        
        # Repulsive force: push points apart based on inverse distance
        # Force on point i from point j is proportional to 1/(1 - angle_ij)
        # where angle_ij is the angular distance
        forces = np.zeros_like(X)

                        diff = X[i] - X[j]
                        # Remove radial component
